mapper.select: SELECT ACTIVITY_ID AS activityId, ACTIVITY_NAME AS activityName, ACTIVITY_TYPE AS activityType, CAL_PER_MIN AS calPerMin, USE_YN AS useYn, CREATED_AT AS createdAt, UPDATED_AT AS updateAt FROM ACTIVITY_TBL WHERE ACTIVITY_NAME LIKE '%'||#{keyword}||'%' AND USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY ACTIVITY_NAME ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ACTIVITY_LOG_TBL ( LOG_ID, USER_NO, ACTIVITY_ID, DURATION_MIN, CALORIES, SOURCE_TYPE, WEIGHT_LEVEL, INTENSITY_FACTOR ) VALUES ( SEQ_ACTIVITY_LOG_NO.NEXTVAL, #{userNo}, #{activityId}, #{durationMin}, #{calories}, #{sourceType}, #{weightLevel}, #{intensityLevel} )
mapper.select: SELECT l.LOG_ID AS "logId", l.USER_NO AS "userNo", l.ACTIVITY_ID AS "activityId", a.ACTIVITY_NAME AS "activityName", a.ACTIVITY_TYPE AS "activityType", NVL(l.DURATION_MIN,0) AS "durationMin", NVL(l.CALORIES,0) AS "calories", NVL(l.WEIGHT_LEVEL,0) AS "weightLevel", NVL(l.INTENSITY_FACTOR,0) AS "intensityFactor", l.ACTION_AT AS "actionAt" FROM ACTIVITY_LOG_TBL l JOIN ACTIVITY_TBL a ON l.ACTIVITY_ID = a.ACTIVITY_ID WHERE l.USER_NO = #{userNo} AND TRUNC(l.ACTION_AT) = TO_DATE(#{actionDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ORDER BY l.ACTION_AT DESC, l.LOG_ID DESC

SELECT NVL(SUM(l.DURATION_MIN),0) AS "totalMinutes", NVL(SUM(l.CALORIES),0) AS "totalKcal", COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM ACTIVITY_LOG_TBL l WHERE l.USER_NO = #{userNo} AND TRUNC(l.ACTION_AT) = TO_DATE(#{actionDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')

SELECT a.ACTIVITY_TYPE AS "activityType", NVL(SUM(l.CALORIES),0) AS "kcal" FROM ACTIVITY_LOG_TBL l JOIN ACTIVITY_TBL a ON l.ACTIVITY_ID = a.ACTIVITY_ID WHERE l.USER_NO = #{userNo} AND TRUNC(l.ACTION_AT) = TO_DATE(#{actionDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') GROUP BY a.ACTIVITY_TYPE
